findings.title: Esirgenen beslenme, acı verici yoksunluk olarak geri döner
findings.claim: Odaktaki azap, besleme ve yoksunluk karşıtlıklarının kurduğu düzene geri dönen, acı verici bir karşılık olarak belirir.
findings.mechanism: 89:25:3 ve 89:25:4'teki cezalandırma taşıyıcıları, beslememe, yiyeceğin boğazda kalması ve ağır gün temaslarıyla buluşur; böylece kökün yeme-içmeden durma ve alıkoyma dalları, cezalandırmayı genelleştirilmiş bir acıdan esirgenmiş geçimin acısına doğru renklendirir.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, azabı yalnızca dışarıdan gelen acı olarak değil, başkasından esirgenen geçimin geri dönen ölçüsü olarak da fark eder.
findings.containment: Bu, azabın burada sözlük bakımından açlık demek olduğunu veya her cezanın yiyecek yoksunluğu olduğunu söylemez. Besleme yönündeki olumlu örnekler ve karşıt bağlantı kayıtları bu teması bağlamsal bir yankı olarak sınırlar.

epistemic.reason: Güvenilir çapraz-çalışma kaydı odak taşıyıcısını ve yoksunluk ilişkisini verir; legacy bağlantı/okuma malzemesi beslenme temasını genişletir, ancak hedef ayetlerin tam morfolojisi supplied değildir.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsan veya hayvan fiilen yiyecek ve içecek tüketmeden durur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb and possessed punishment noun carry the ordinary penal relation while leaving the root's deprivation pressure available as a contextual carrier.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider rows connect painful consequence with choking food and with failure to urge or provide feeding.
branch_activations.activation: The focus punishment carrier meets the separate food-deprivation contacts, so the penal relation can be felt as deprivation without replacing its ordinary punishment sense.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Punishment acquires a bounded echo of provision withheld or made painfully unavailable.
branch_activations.boundary: The deprivation facet is contextual; the Form II verb is not translated as literal fasting or hunger here.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi başkasını bir işten uzak tutar veya o işi ona bıraktırır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus punishment relation carries the root's ordinary capacity to describe a painful consequence.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider connections repeatedly supply refusal to mobilize or provide food for the needy.
branch_activations.activation: The alıkoyma relation meets the focus punishment carrier, making the consequence legible as a return of a social act that withheld provision.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment retains its penal floor while reflecting the withholding economy that preceded the judgment language.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that 89:25 names a specific historical food offense or that alıkoyma is the sole sense of the focus root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.
branch_activations.carrier: The Form II verb and its possessed verbal noun carry severe punishment as the focus's ordinary semantic floor.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider target rows join painful punishment to the severe Day and to the food-related moral contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The ordinary punishment carrier meets the supplied deprivation frame, so its pain becomes a measured consequence within that frame.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus punishment is heard as a painful return within a provision-and-refusal relation, while remaining punishment.
branch_activations.boundary: The contextual measure-for-measure inference does not erase other causes or forms of punishment.

findings.title: Hesap başkasına aktarılamayan kişisel karşılaşmaya dönüşür
findings.claim: Son أَحَد, azabı yalnızca eşsiz kılmaz; hesaplaşmayı her kişinin yerine başka biri geçemeyecek biçimde kişisel bir karşılaşma olarak kapatır.
findings.mechanism: Negatif yapı, odaktaki أَحَد taşıyıcısını bütün olası kişiler sınıfını dışlayan bir kapanışa dönüştürür; supplied accountability and no-intervention contacts then return through that word and the punishment carrier, while the later individual-address cue keeps the encounter person-by-person.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, rakipsiz cezayı soyut bir üstünlük cümlesi olarak değil, sorumluluğun vekile veya ortak katılıma devredilemediği bir karşılaşma olarak görür.
findings.containment: Bu ilişki belirli bir hukukî aracılık modelini veya çevredeki bütün أَحَد kullanımlarını tanımlamaz. Olumsuzluk altındaki kişi kapsamı ve cezalandırma zemini korunur; yalnızca bunların kişisel hesap etkisi görünür kılınır.

epistemic.reason: Güvenilir yayın kaydı kişi kişi hesap ilişkisini verir; legacy yürüyüşü ve hedef bağlantıları bu ilişkiyi bireysel ve müdahalesiz karşılaşma yönünde açar, fakat hedef morfolojisi tam sunulmamıştır.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: The final indefinite under negation carries exhaustive exclusion of any possible person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied later singular sequence and wider no-immunity/no-intervention contacts make substitution and collective escape the live alternatives.
branch_activations.activation: Exhaustive person-exclusion meets the individual encounter cues, so the focus's no-one closure becomes a no-surrogate closure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: No one can stand in for the person whose account the punishment reaches.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch remains the negative person-quantifier; it is not converted into a positive uniqueness or theological proper-name reading.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tek başına kalma ve birer birer gelme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişinin bir işi başkalarından ayrı olarak üstlenmesini veya tek başına kalmasını bildirir.
branch_activations.carrier: The final aḥad form carries an individually isolated person within the focus's negative closure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The one-self address and the supplied exclusion of collective intervention provide the separate accountability frame.
branch_activations.activation: Individual isolation meets the no-intervention contact, making the focus's final person a non-substitutable bearer of the encounter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment reaches one person at a time without another participant absorbing it.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not state that the focus explains every later outcome or that no relational help exists in any other context.

findings.title: Cezanın eşsizliği yalnız şiddet değil, rakipsiz icradır
findings.claim: Fiil ile nesnenin aynı cezalandırma kökünde yankılanması ve son أَحَد'ın kapanışı, cezayı yalnız ağır değil, başka bir failce eşdeğer biçimde gerçekleştirilemeyecek bir eylem olarak duyurur.
findings.mechanism: The focus punishment verb and verbal noun supply the repeated penal carrier; negative أَحَد closes the class of possible equals, while the supplied exclusivity and unmatched-punishment parallels independently sharpen the comparison.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, cümlenin üstünlük bildiren yüzünün yanında cezalandırmanın biçim ve fail bakımından rakipsiz olduğu baskıyı da fark eder.
findings.containment: 112:1 eşsizliği aydınlatır fakat tek başına ceza içeriği sağlamaz; 5:115 ve 69:47 bağlantıları da hedef morfolojisi tam verilmemiş yüzey kayıtlarıdır. B001 burada olumlu çevirinin yerine değil, olumsuz kapanışta duyulan eşsizlik yankısına aittir.

epistemic.reason: Legacy yürüyüş kayıtları odak tekrarını ve eşsizlik baskısını açıkça aday gösterir; supplied connection rows wider exclusivity and punishment parallels sağlar, ancak bunların hedef morfolojisi tam değildir.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlığı bir tane, tek veya eşi bulunmayan olarak gösterir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied exclusivity and unmatched-punishment contacts give that pressure a wider comparison frame.
branch_activations.activation: The focus form meets independent exclusivity and unmatchedness cues, making the negative closure resonate as more than a bare count of persons.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment is heard as without an equal in execution as well as without an admitted person in the negative scope.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a qualified resonance under negation, not a replacement of the contextually selected negative-person branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Olumsuzluk altında konuşmaya konu olabilecek kişiler türünün tamamını kapsar.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied no-intervention and unmatched-punishment contacts remove the live possibility of a comparable participant.
branch_activations.activation: No-one scope meets no-equal punishment contact, producing an exhaustive denial of rival execution.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment is not merely one severe instance among others; the comparison class itself is closed.
branch_activations.boundary: The reading remains an inferred comparison effect, not a claim that the grammar alone states every theological implication.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.

branch_activations.activation: The ordinary penal carrier meets those independent comparison cues, so severity becomes incomparable execution.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: No rival can perform the same punishment in its defining force and form.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not rank this reading over other focus effects or claim that every surrounding punishment formula is identical.

findings.claim: Odaktaki ceza, eşleştirilmemiş ve başkasına devredilememiş bir karşılaşma olarak da görünür; onu paylaşacak veya araya girecek ikinci taraf yoktur.

findings.claim: Odaktaki azap, yalnızca şiddeti ölçülen bir sonuç değil, sahibi, iletim hareketi, aracı ve gözetim noktası belirginleşmiş egemen bir cezalandırma işleyişi olarak görünür.
findings.mechanism: The focus punishment and exhaustive-person carriers meet the attributed 89:13 ownership, pouring, lash, and repeated punishment roles and the 89:14 watchpoint; the wider no-intervention contact closes the possibility of a rival procedure.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, 'kimse yapamaz' cümlesinin arkasında tek bir şiddet ölçüsünden daha düzenli, yönlendirilmiş ve izlenen bir cezalandırma süreci algılar.
findings.containment: All non-focus word coordinates come from a legacy-unbound HFT trace and the target morphology is not supplied. The finding therefore keeps unresolved context branches attributed and does not claim that 89:25 itself enumerates every instrument or stage literally.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies every role and anchor, while the reader identity is legacy_unbound and the wider target morphology is absent; the process relation is retained as attributed contextual evidence.

findings.title: Korunmuş yapıdan örtüsüz bırakılmaya
findings.claim: Azap, kurulu desteklerin ve koruma düzenlerinin düzleştirilmesinden sonra kişinin örtüsüz ve tek başına bırakıldığı keşifsel bir karşıtlık içinde de görülebilir.
findings.mechanism: The focus root's attributed uncovered-toward-the-sky branch and the individual-isolation branch meet the exact support, carved-rock, stakes, leveling, and garden roles across 89:7, 89:9, 89:10, 89:21, and 89:30; constructed protection is followed by leveling and contrasted with final enclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: Okur, cezayı yalnız acı verilmesi olarak değil, dayanılan koruyucu düzenin çözülmesi ve kişinin son sığınağın dışında kalması olarak da imgeleyebilir.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory spatial analogy. The focus word is not translated as literal exposure, unresolved context branches receive no invented gloss or facet, and the garden is a contrasting boundary rather than a claim that 89:25 itself promises entry or exclusion.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies complete coordinates and before/after roles, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound, the contextual branches are unresolved, and the shelter-loss axis is an explicitly exploratory inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Varlık ile gökyüzü arasında onu örten hiçbir engel bulunmaz.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus root carries the attributed condition of being left without an upper covering toward the sky.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact leveling sequence and final sheltered garden supply the separate exposure-and-enclosure contrast.
branch_activations.activation: The uncovered branch meets the movement from demolished supports to final enclosure, allowing punishment to be colored as loss of shelter.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punished person appears exposed outside a protection that has been removed.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus's ordinary penal sense remains intact; exposedness is an attributed exploratory resonance.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tek başına kalma ve birer birer gelme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişinin bir işi başkalarından ayrı olarak üstlenmesini veya tek başına kalmasını bildirir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: Leveling and the later enclosed garden supply the separate poles of exposure and protection.
branch_activations.activation: Individual isolation meets the loss-and-enclosure sequence, making the unsheltering condition personally borne.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus does not describe an anonymous collapse only; the exposed condition reaches one person at a time.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the negative-person scope or claim a literal spatial referent for أَحَد.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinate supplies structural support placed beneath or against an elevated formation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus punishment carrier supplies the separate condition whose spatial coloring is being tested.
branch_activations.activation: Constructed support meets the focus's attributed shelter-loss branch, making protection a visible thing that can be removed.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The punishment can be imagined against the background of supports that once held a protected order up.
branch_activations.boundary: No registered gloss or facet is supplied for this context branch; the support role remains attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinate supplies cutting through solid material to make inhabitable form.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus uncovered branch supplies the separate condition in which protection is absent.
branch_activations.activation: Cutting and inhabitable form meet the focus's exposure image, making shelter a constructed achievement rather than a given condition.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The loss of protection can be felt as the reversal of a built opening into a space no longer sheltered.
branch_activations.boundary: The unresolved cutting branch is not given a dictionary gloss and the focus is not redefined as architecture.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinate supplies massive hard rock as the durable material of the protective order.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus punishment and exposure carriers supply the separate condition against which that durability is reversed.
branch_activations.activation: Hard-rock durability meets the focus shelter-loss relation, making apparent permanence vulnerable to the later leveling.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What looks able to shelter can still become the background of exposure once its durable form is undone.
branch_activations.boundary: The hard-rock role is attributed contextual evidence and does not establish a literal material for the focus punishment.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinate supplies peg-like upright anchorage and resistance to displacement.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus exposure carrier supplies the separate condition in which anchorage no longer protects.
branch_activations.activation: Anchorage meets the focus shelter-loss image, so the punishment is colored by the removal of what once resisted displacement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The exposed individual stands after the anchoring order has failed or been taken away.
branch_activations.boundary: This remains an attributed structural analogy; no literal stakes or displacement event is assigned to 89:25.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinates supply repeated pounding and demolition until the earth is level.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus uncovered and punishment carriers supply the separate condition whose protection is being removed.
branch_activations.activation: Repeated leveling meets shelter-loss, making the punishment an exploratory aftermath of supports being brought down.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus exposure is newly perceptible after the terrain that carried protection has been flattened.
branch_activations.boundary: The leveling role is attributed and does not prove that 89:25 describes a physical demolition.

branch_activations.carrier: The exact HFT coordinate supplies a garden enclosed by concealing vegetation as the positive shelter pole.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus exposure carrier supplies the separate negative spatial pole to which the enclosed garden returns.
